children: of 5M units at C$0.20 each for gross proceeds of C$1M, subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.
Each unit includes one common share and half a warrant, with each full warrant exercisable at C$0.25 for 24 months.
The company can accelerate expiry if its shares trade at or above C$0.45 for 10 consecutive trading days.

The net proceeds and existing working capital will be used to advance the 100%-owned River Valley Palladium Project in Ontario, including Phase II PLATSOL™ metallurgical testing and PGM recovery studies.
The remaining funds will support First Nations consultation, exploration data work, mineral property maintenance, technical activities, marketing, investor relations, and general working capital.
The offering is anticipated to close on or about September 22, 2026, subject to required approvals.
